with date_in_2002_march as (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_year = 2002 and d_month_seq = 3)
select cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) 
from customer c
join customer_address ca on c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
join customer_demographics cd on cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
where ca_state in ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
and exists (select * from store_sales ss where ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = date_in_2002_march.d_date_sk)
and not exists (select * from web_sales ws where ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = date_in_2002_march.d_date_sk)
and not exists (select * from catalog_sales cs where cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = date_in_2002_march.d_date_sk)
group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) 
order by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) 
limit 100
